sharedRules.name: Power From Pain
sharedRules.description:
Pain abilities only apply to a unit while it is Empowered. While an Attached unit is Empowered, the Pain abilities of all its Leader and Bodyguard units take effect, with no additional spend.
If your Army Faction is DRUKHARI:
  - At the start of your Command phase, you gain 1 Pain token.
  - Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, you gain 1 Pain token.
  - When an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test, you gain 1 Pain token.
  - Each time you spend Pain tokens to Empower a friendly unit, you can use this ability, until the end of the phase, the triggering unit is Empowered.

sharedRules.name: Corsairs and Travelling Players
sharedRules.description:

rules.name: Combat Drugs
rules.description:
At the start of your Command phase, until the start of your next Command phase:
  - Select one (each can be chosen once per battle):
    - Adrenalight: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by friendly WYCH CULT models.
    - Hypex: Add 2" to friendly WYCH CULT models' Move characteristic.
    - Serpentin: Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by friendly WYCH CULT models by 1.
    - Painbringer: Add 1 to friendly WYCH CULT models' Toughness characteristic.
    - Grave Lotus: Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by friendly WYCH CULT models.
    - Splintermind: Improve friendly WYCH CULT models' Leadership characteristic by 1; improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by friendly WYCH CULT models by 1.
  - Or, instead of selecting, roll two D6: each result applies the option it numbers (1 Adrenalight, 2 Hypex, 3 Serpentin, 4 Painbringer, 5 Grave Lotus, 6 Splintermind); a result already active has no additional effect.

  - Ranged weapons equipped by that unit gain [IGNORES COVER].
  - Melee weapons equipped by that unit gain [LANCE].

rules.name: Callous Competition
rules.description:
At the start of the battle:
  - Friendly DRUKHARI units are designated as Winning the Wager.
  - Friendly DRUKHARI units are no longer designated as Losing the Wager.
  - Friendly HARLEQUINS units are designated as Losing the Wager.
  - Friendly HARLEQUINS units are no longer designated as Winning the Wager.
Each time a friendly DRUKHARI unit destroys an enemy unit:
  - Friendly DRUKHARI units are designated as Winning the Wager.
  - Friendly DRUKHARI units are no longer designated as Losing the Wager.
  - Friendly HARLEQUINS units are designated as Losing the Wager.
  - Friendly HARLEQUINS units are no longer designated as Winning the Wager.
Each time a friendly HARLEQUINS unit destroys an enemy unit:
  - Friendly HARLEQUINS units are designated as Winning the Wager.
  - Friendly HARLEQUINS units are no longer designated as Losing the Wager.
  - Friendly DRUKHARI units are designated as Losing the Wager.
  - Friendly DRUKHARI units are no longer designated as Winning the Wager.
While the attacking unit is designated as Winning the Wager and the attacking unit is not designated as Losing the Wager, you can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly models with the DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS keyword.
While the attacking unit is designated as Losing the Wager, you can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly models with the DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS keyword.
While the attacking unit is designated as Losing the Wager, you can re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly models with the DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS keyword.

rules.name: Alliance of Agony
rules.description:
At the start of the battle, for the rest of the battle:
  - If this unit is an ARCHON KABALITE WARRIORS unit, you gain 2 Pain tokens.
  - If this unit is a SUCCUBUS WYCHES unit, you gain 2 Pain tokens.
  - If this unit is a HAEMONCULUS WRACKS unit, you gain 2 Pain tokens.

rules.name: Stitchflesh Abominations
rules.description: Against HAEMONCULUS COVENS targets, when the attack's S is more than the target's T, subtract 1 from the attacking unit's Wound rolls.

rules.name: Exacting Cruelty
rules.description:
Against a unit that is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE, melee weapons equipped by friendly WYCH CULT units gain [LETHAL HITS].
You cannot select this Detachment together with another WYCH CULT Detachment.

rules.name: Contracted Harvest
rules.description:
Against a unit that is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE, ranged weapons equipped by friendly units with the BLADES FOR HIRE or KABAL keyword gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
You cannot select this Detachment together with another KABAL Detachment.

rules.name: Darkest Artifice
rules.description:
While the target is a friendly unit with the CRONOS or TALOS keyword, when the attack's S is more than the target's T, subtract 1 from the attacking unit's Wound rolls.
You cannot select this Detachment together with another COVENS Detachment.
